what_is_closed: The strongest local source candidates are compared field-by-field with the three Core input contracts.
Candidate numeric rows, standard-physics comparators, and missing UET mappings are separated.
No candidate is accepted for Core merely because its lane artifact is PASS.
No target-fit violation is emitted; holdout verification remains fail-closed when candidate metadata is incomplete.
major_result.dependency_unlocked: None; this diagnostic only narrows evidence acquisition.

equation_or_mapping.transport: KuboRecord -> physical coefficient only after matched Phi/SK/KMS/entropy provenance

major_result.derivation_class: candidate compatibility and provenance audit; no new physical derivation
major_result.observable: Core input-package coverage and remaining closure distance

evidence_artifacts.claim_boundary: This closes only a source-locked Calorine/Zenodo harmonic/RTA PBTE candidate reproduction lane. It is not Ding-regime equivalence, not source-grade uncertainty closure, not an alpha_Phi_K calibration, not a UET Phi map, not a TTG prediction, and not Full Topic 13 closure.

The package closes an independent harmonic graphite c_v comparator lane with auditable provenance and explicit non-statistical uncertainty bounds. It does not close Ding-specific PBTE C_src(T), e0, base Phi-to-energy correspondence, alpha_Phi_K, EOS, transport, SK/KMS, entropy, external validation, or global UET closure.

QH-15 is a source-locked macroscopic graphite C_v comparator with an explicit unit conversion and a bounded cross-check against the independent Calorine candidate. It is not Ding mode-resolved C_src, not an alpha_Phi_K calibration, not a Phi-to-temperature map, not external validation, and not Full Topic 13 closure.

This package source-locks one independent c_p row and its 95% confidence interval at 573.15 K. Its reported thermal conductivity is derived from diffusivity, c_p, and an assumed density, so it cannot independently source-lock density or volumetric c_v. It does not derive e0, identify Phi with Phi_E, or calibrate alpha_Phi_K.

This package closes only a source-locked standard-physics Green-Kubo transport-input lane. It does not identify the coefficient with UET Phi response, does not provide Ding mode-resolved C_src, does not calibrate alpha_Phi_K, and does not close Full Topic 13.

major_result.controlling_blocker: three grouped input packages remain unaccepted
